title: Kinrows for blended families
description: How a blended family can keep two households, two calendars and one set of kids organized without duplicate lists.
directAnswer: Blended families juggle two households, two calendars, and often two sets of rules, which makes a single shared source of truth more useful, not less. Kinrows lets each household keep its own space while sharing the calendar, lists, and updates that matter for the kids across both homes, without either parent losing visibility.

sections.heading: One shared calendar, two homes
sections.html: Custody schedules, school events and appointments live in one calendar both households can see.

cta.heading: Keep both households in sync
cta.body: Kinrows keeps the calendar and lists visible across every household that needs them.
